sourceRoles.role: PARTIAL COVERAGE AUDIT INTAKE; SUPERSEDED ONLY BY SCOPED LATER EVIDENCE
sourceRoles.judgment: First two of20 original partial clauses audited. Tolerance branch qualifies bounded disjunction, not sensitization or universal adaptation. Interoceptive uncertainty still requires a character-side quality/consumer comparison.

sourceRoles.role: PARTIAL COVERAGE AUDIT INTAKE; SUPERSEDED ONLY BY SCOPED LATER EVIDENCE
sourceRoles.judgment: Motive audit distinguishes general importance from current urgency. One motive/multiple actions gains bounded substitution evidence with separate native corroboration, not option discovery or native substitution admission.

sourceRoles.role: PARTIAL COVERAGE AUDIT INTAKE; SUPERSEDED ONLY BY SCOPED LATER EVIDENCE
sourceRoles.judgment: Memory audit leaves vividness and actual affect-biased retrieval partial; controlled episode/category consolidation qualifies without general fusion or downstream reuse. Duplicated prior citations/RO references remain occurrences, not independent corroboration.

sourceRoles.role: PARTIAL COVERAGE AUDIT INTAKE; SUPERSEDED ONLY BY SCOPED LATER EVIDENCE
sourceRoles.judgment: Belief audit leaves uncertainty/accuracy and hidden-cause diagnosis partial. Repeated admitted prediction discrepancy is bounded component evidence, not a general surprise law or new native source.

sourceRoles.role: PARTIAL COVERAGE AUDIT INTAKE; SUPERSEDED ONLY BY SCOPED LATER EVIDENCE
sourceRoles.judgment: Affect audit qualifies positive threat with chosen continuation under competing commitment, not literal locomotor flight. Salience/retrieval needs an actual consumer; independent factors alone do not prove a named scalar reduction insufficient.

sourceRoles.role: PARTIAL COVERAGE AUDIT INTAKE; SUPERSEDED ONLY BY SCOPED LATER EVIDENCE
sourceRoles.judgment: Identity/agency audit requires shared cross-context meaning, enacted coercion, and cross-episode interference expectation. Eligibility filtering alone is not enacted coercion, and no intended action is rewritten by observed failure.

sourceRoles.role: PARTIAL COVERAGE AUDIT INTAKE; SUPERSEDED ONLY BY SCOPED LATER EVIDENCE
sourceRoles.judgment: All20 starting clauses audited, five bounded and15 partial, not final campaign coverage. Scheduled repetition is not routine; instructions are not adopted goals; skill practice is not habitual access; detail expiry is not personal loss. Joined biography/retention comparisons remain the next gate. Later exact clause evidence supersedes these pending statuses without widening old fixtures.
